classification: paired industry and industry-plus-size neutralization test for a weak-regime sentiment-reversal B sleeve
hypothesis: R365 raw 20-session weak-reversal blend recovered recent return (+7.94%) but lagged its matched quality control in annual return, Sharpe and MDD. Existing score-neutralization applied equally to all scoring legs of candidate and control may reduce industry/size exposure while preserving the paired comparison. Industry-only is a mechanism diagnostic; industry plus log_float_mv is primary.
known_limits: R365 and R366 share overlapping historical observations; not independent out-of-sample evidence.
Current THS industry classifications are backfilled historically, not PIT.
Historical HS300 membership is daily after 2020-12 and monthly earlier; survivorship and membership bias remain.
log_float_mv is a turnover-implied cap proxy and inherits turnover/share-count limitations.
Neutralizing all legs including industry-relative strength and industry momentum changes the ranking construct rather than isolating reversal alpha.
Holding cap, weak-regime filter and stop can interact; result is not a causal estimate of factor alpha.
2x/3x labels are transaction-cost scenarios, not leverage; gross exposure <=100%.

performance_gates.G1_candidate_annual_no_more_than_5pp_bel: Industry+size candidate 2x annual >= raw R365 candidate annual -5pp.
performance_gates.G2_candidate_sharpe_no_more_than_0_15_be: Industry+size candidate Sharpe >= raw R365 candidate Sharpe -0.15.
performance_gates.G3_candidate_mdd_no_more_than_3pp_worse_: Industry+size candidate MDD >= raw R365 candidate MDD -3pp.
performance_gates.G4_candidate_control_edge_no_more_than_2: Neutral candidate-control annual margin >= raw R365 candidate-control margin -2pp.
performance_gates.G5_candidate_recent_no_more_than_2pp_bel: Neutral candidate recent 2x >= raw R365 candidate recent -2pp.
performance_gates.G6_candidate_annual_within_1pp_of_neutra: Neutral candidate annual >= neutral control annual -1pp.
performance_gates.G7_at_least_4_of_6_candidate_phases_posi: At least 4/6 fixed phase-start neutral candidate returns positive.

preflight_gates.D1: Candidate/control score, filters, 20-session cap and -20% stop frozen for both variants.
preflight_gates.D2: Composite, both components, industry and size columns materialize in isolated panel.
preflight_gates.D3: At least 100 T-1 weak days; >=10 eligible HS300 candidates per day.
preflight_gates.D5: Each of six phase starts has >=5 weak days; regime/membership cover window.
preflight_gates.D6: Inputs stable; no forward return or backtest metric evaluated.

primary_metric.definition: Industry+size neutral candidate 2x annualized return minus matched neutral quality control; compare margin to raw R365 candidate-control margin, and report annual, Sharpe, MDD, recent return, phases and 3x costs.
primary_metric.name: primary_industry_size_candidate_vs_control_annual_2x

research_basis.R17: The existing score neutralization uses within-industry daily z-score and log_float_mv regression residualization. Prior R17 warned that partial neutralization with retained size legs can amplify size exposure; R366 neutralizes every scoring leg.
research_basis.R365: Raw 20-session candidate: 2x annual 30.82%, Sharpe 0.995, MDD -30.85%, recent +7.94%; matched quality control annual 38.14%, Sharpe 1.192, MDD -23.44%, recent +15.67%.
research_basis.R98: Historical-member tests showed quality/macro strategy results were sensitive to industry and size neutralization; effects vary and are not presumed beneficial.
research_basis.design: Use StrategyBacktestService with identical candidate/control rules within each neutralization variant; compare to the paired raw R365 candidate/control.

rule.execution: T close ranking; T+1 open; 2x/3x transaction-cost cases; no leverage or borrowing
rule.only_variant_difference: All score legs are neutralized; within each variant candidate/control differ only by replacing 20pp of quality-value with the fixed 50/50 reversal composite.
